name: Gopal Snacks Ltd
title: Gopal Snacks Ltd - 544140 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Gopal Snacks Q4 revenue Rs 409.6 cr (+29% YoY) with Rajkot plant back and Modasa integrated; FY27 EBITDA guided 8-9% while palm oil/packaging inflation of 4-4.5% is being offset via grammage cuts and price hikes.

utilisation.quote: Capacity utilization would be roughly around 43% to 45%.
